A '''Gran''' [[Gender/Legends|male]] was employed by [[Urdruua]] [[Hutt/Legends|the Hutt]], and worked for the Hutt up until three [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], the first battle of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], which began during [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. The Gran worked with the Hutt at his [[palace]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], and was present when Urdruua posted a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on the ex-[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]]. After escaping numerous [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], Sing detonated a [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]] inside Urdruua's palace, killing the Hutt, Gran, and and many others inside.

==Biography==
A [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] was employed by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Gangster/Legends|gangster]] [[Urdruua]] sometime around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. During a prior event, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] and her [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[The Dark Woman|An'ya Kuro]] ran afoul of Urdruua that left the Hutt with a grudge. Unable to let it go, he placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Sing three [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the outbreak of an [[The galaxy/Legends|intergalactic]] conflict known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], although the bounty actually called for the [[Death/Legends|death]] of a Jedi, leaving Sing's name ambiguous.<ref name="OS" />

Aurra Sing had since become a Jedi killer after leaving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and accepted the mission to kill a Jedi. Arriving at Urdruua's [[palace]], located on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], she conversed briefly with the Gran and the Hutt before Urdruua attempted to kill her with [[Poison/Legends|poison]] gas, which began to fill the throne room from a set of large pipes. Urdruua sealed himself and the Gran behind a blast door as Sing escaped through one of the spacious pipes.<ref name="OS" />

Urdruua later admitted to the Gran that he did not expect the attempt to kill her, instead hoping that large number of other [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] he had hired would. The pair took little notice of the [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] that Sing had left behind. Sing rampaged through the streets of Nar Shaddaa, killing or subduing each of the bounty hunters that had been hired to kill her.<ref name="OS" />

After stealing a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] and escaping [[Smart mine/Legends|smart mines]], Sing contacted Urdruua and the Gran, telling the Hutt that he should've let go of the past. She then activated a [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]] within the holoprojector that destroyed the palace, killing Urdruua and the Gran in the process.<ref name="OS" />

==Personality and traits==
Urdruua was talkative, and during the debacle with Aurra Sing, would constantly explain his plans and thoughts to the Gran as the events progressed. The Gran, however, appeared entirely uninterested in what the Hutt had to say. The Gran had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and brown colored skin.<ref name="OS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Gran was created for the short story ''[[Old Scores]]'', which was one of four stories compiled into the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume 8|eighth volume]] of the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (graphic novels)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] [[Star Wars comic books|trade paperback]] series. ''Old Scores'' was written by [[Chris Avellone]], and was illustrated by [[Matthew Fillbach|Matthew]] and [[Shawn Fillbach]], and colored by [[Pamela Rambo]].<ref name="OS" />
